transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Card Services. My name is Marcus. How can I help you today?
Customer: Hi, I'm calling because I returned something to a store recently, but the money hasn't shown back up on my card yet.
Agent: I can look into that for you. May I have your full name and the billing zip code on the account?
Customer: Sure, my name is Elliot Raskin, and the zip code is 43210.
Agent: Thank you, Mr. Raskin. Could you tell me the name of the merchant and the amount in question?
Customer: It was ByteBarn Computers, and the amount was $1,099.00.
Agent: Got it. And what date was that original charge made?
Customer: That was back on September 26th. It showed up on my October 6th statement.
Agent: Thank you. Can you tell me a little more about what happened when you went back to the merchant?
Customer: Yeah, it was a laptop. I took it back to the store in person, and the cashier took it and handed me a refund slip.
Agent: When did you bring the item back to the store?
Customer: That was seven business days ago.
Agent: And do you currently have that paperwork from the store with you?
Customer: Yes, I'm looking right at the refund slip, but the refund isn't on the account when I check my balance online.
Agent: So to make sure I have the facts straight, you purchased a laptop at ByteBarn Computers on September 26th for $1,099.00, which was on your October 6th statement, and then you returned it in store seven business days ago and received a slip, but the money hasn't appeared on your card.
Customer: Yes, that is correct.
